status: draft; endpoint and notes of the local arm are filled in at T5.2; model and repeats.dev at T5.4; repeats.eval at T6.4
rules: Both arms use the same request builder and receive the same question set.
An arm with auth_env set must use https and a host listed in allowed_hosts.
An arm without auth_env must use a loopback host, reads no key and sends no Authorization header.
Notes contain version numbers, hashes and repository-relative paths only. No local absolute paths.
run uses repeats.dev for the dev role and repeats.eval for the test and heldout roles.

notes.weights: ZefanCai/Open-Jev-2B (Apache-2.0), LoRA adapter and scalar decision head; base weights are a Qwen3.5-2B checkpoint; this is a non-generative decision model, not a Qwen answer-generation run
notes.input_limit: 4096 tokens per independently scored candidate; longer input is rejected, not truncated
to_record_at_T5_4: model field of the first smoke response

notes.pin: jev-latest and jev-preview are aliases and must not be used
notes.limits: 64k tokens per request; state plus longest question 32k
notes.terms: outputs must not be used to distil or train a model (Master Customer Agreement 2.3(b))
notes.who_runs: every run and smoke command of this arm is executed by the owner in the owner's own terminal
